blocks.text: going to — qaror allaqachon qabul qilingan

**am / is / are going to + V1** — asoslari qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 26-dars). Bu shaklning birinchi ma'nosi — **niyat**: biz nima qilishni gapirishdan **oldin** hal qilib qo'yganmiz. O'zbekchada bunga «**-moqchiman**», «...ishga qaror qildim» mos keladi: I**'m going to** learn Spanish — Ispan tilini **o'rganmoqchiman**. Qaror aynan gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilinsa — **will** (→ 21-dars); reja boshqalar bilan kelishilgan bo'lsa — Present Continuous ham ishlatiladi (→ 19-dars).

rows: I**'m going to** sell my car.
I thought it **was going to** rain.

items.text: We**'re going to** have a big party for Grandma's eightieth.
**Is** Tom **going to** take the job in Leeds?
I**'m not going to** wait any longer.

blocks.text: going to va Present Continuous: niyat va kelishuv

**going to** — **qaror** bor, lekin hali hech narsa tashkil qilinmagan bo'lishi mumkin; **Present Continuous** — qaror qilingan **va tashkil qilingan** (vaqt, joy, boshqa odamlar bilan kelishilgan). I**'m going to** visit my aunt one day (niyat) — I**'m visiting** my aunt on Sunday (kelishilgan). Kelishilgan rejalarda ko'pincha ikkalasi ham to'g'ri. go va come fe'llari bilan «going to go» o'rniga odatda oddiy Present Continuous ishlatiladi: I**'m going** to the cinema tonight (I'm going to go ... — og'irroq).

items.text: I**'m going to** ask Madina to help me.
I**'m meeting** Madina at five to discuss it.
items.translation: Buni muhokama qilish uchun soat beshda Madina bilan **uchrashaman**.

items.text: Are you **going** to the match on Saturday?

blocks.text: Ikkinchi ma'no — **bashorat**, lekin taxmin emas, **hozir ko'rinib turgan belgiga** asoslangan: osmonda qora bulutlar — It**'s going to** rain; bola daraxtning ingichka shoxida — He**'s going to** fall! Voqea ko'pincha juda yaqin, hatto boshlanib qolgan. O'zbekchada: «Hozir yomg'ir **yog'adi**», «**Yiqilasan**!», «**Kechikamiz**». will bilan qilingan bashorat esa ko'proq **fikr**ga asoslanadi (I think it will rain tomorrow, → 22–23-darslar).

items.text: Look at the sky — **it's going to** snow.
Slow down! You**'re going to** hit that car!
I've eaten too much; I**'m going to** be sick.

blocks.text: **was / were going to** — o'tmishdagi niyat, ko'pincha **amalga oshmagan**: I **was going to** call you, but I forgot. Bu o'zbekchadagi «**-moqchi edim**» ning aynan o'zi — «qo'ng'iroq qilmoqchi edim, lekin esimdan chiqibdi». Gapning davomida odatda **but** keladi. Xuddi shu shakl o'tmishdagi bashorat uchun ham ishlatiladi: I thought it **was going to** rain, but it didn't — Yomg'ir yog'adi deb o'ylagandim, lekin yog'madi.

rows: We **were going to** travel by train ...
She **was going to** buy that dress ...
... but someone else bought it first.
... but it was too exciting to keep secret.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I going to visit my aunt» → I**'m going to** visit (be tushib qolmasin); «I'm going to swimming» → I**'m going to swim** yoki I**'m going swimming**; «I decided last week — I will buy a car» → I**'m going to** buy a car (qaror oldin qilingan); qora bulutlarga qarab «It will rain» → tabiiyrog'i: It**'s going to** rain; «-moqchi edim» ni «I wanted to» bilan berish ham mumkin, lekin reja buzilganini aytishning eng tabiiy yo'li — I **was going to** ...
Og'zaki nutqda va qo'shiqlarda going to ko'pincha «**gonna**» deb aytiladi va shunday yoziladi: I'm gonna call her. Rasmiy yozuvda faqat **going to**.

O'zbekchadan tarjima: «**-moqchiman**» → going to; «**-moqchi edim** (lekin ...)» → was going to; «ko'rinib turibdi, hozir **...adi**» → going to (bashorat); «yaxshi, unda **...aman**» (shu zahoti qaror) → will (→ 21-dars).

rows: I**'m going to** paint the bedroom.
We **were going to** stay, but we left early.

examples.title: Intentions: **going to** — already decided
examples.description: Gapirishdan oldin qabul qilingan qaror, niyat: am / is / are going to + V1. O'zbekchada «-moqchiman», «...ishga qaror qildim».

sentences.text: **I'm going to** learn Spanish this year — I've already bought the books.
sentences.translation: Bu yil ispan tilini **o'rganmoqchiman** — kitoblarni allaqachon sotib oldim.

sentences.text: Aziz **is going to** sell his car and buy an electric one.
sentences.translation: Aziz mashinasini sotib, elektromobil **olmoqchi**.

sentences.text: We**'re going to** paint the kitchen yellow at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari oshxonani sariqqa **bo'yamoqchimiz**.

sentences.text: Now that she's graduated, Madina **is going to** look for a job in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Endi o'qishni bitirgach, Madina Toshkentdan ish **qidirmoqchi**.

sentences.text: My parents **are going to** celebrate their anniversary in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam to'y yilligini Samarqandda **nishonlamoqchi**.

sentences.text: After the argument, Tom says he**'s going to** apologise to his sister.
sentences.translation: Janjaldan keyin Tom singlisidan **kechirim so'ramoqchi** ekanini aytyapti.

sentences.text: This summer the twins **are going to** try surfing for the first time.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz egizaklar birinchi marta **serfing qilib ko'rmoqchi**.

sentences.text: Sarah has decided she**'s going to** run the London Marathon next spring.
sentences.translation: Sara kelasi bahorda London marafonida **yugurishga qaror qildi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod**'s going to** propose to Nilufar on her birthday — don't tell anyone!
sentences.translation: Bekzod Nilufarning tug'ilgan kunida unga **turmush qurishni taklif qilmoqchi** — hech kimga aytma!

sentences.text: Since prices keep rising, we**'re going to** cut down on eating out.
sentences.translation: Narxlar oshib borayotgani uchun restoranda ovqatlanishni **kamaytirmoqchimiz**.

examples.title: **Are** you **going to** ...? / **not going to**
examples.description: So'roq — Are you going to ...? («...moqchimisan?»). Inkor — not going to: niyat yo'q yoki qat'iy rad etish («...mayman», «...moqchi emasman»).

sentences.text: **Are** you **going to** apply for the manager's job? — Yes, I think so.
sentences.translation: Menejer lavozimiga **ariza topshirmoqchimisan**? — Ha, shunday deb o'ylayman.

sentences.text: What **is** Emma **going to** do after she finishes school?
sentences.translation: Emma maktabni bitirgach nima **qilmoqchi**?

sentences.text: We**'re not going to** buy a new sofa — this one is fine.
sentences.translation: Yangi divan **sotib olmoqchi emasmiz** — bunisi yaxshi.

sentences.text: **Is** Jasur **going to** invite all his colleagues to the wedding?
sentences.translation: Jasur to'yga barcha hamkasblarini **taklif qilmoqchimi**?

sentences.text: I**'m not going to** apologise, because I did nothing wrong!
sentences.translation: **Kechirim so'ramayman**, chunki hech qanday yomon ish qilmadim!

sentences.text: How **are** you **going to** pay for the trip if you've lost your job?
sentences.translation: Ishdan ayrilgan bo'lsangiz, safar uchun qanday **to'lamoqchisiz**?

sentences.text: Dilnoza **isn't going to** stay in that flat — it's far too noisy.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza o'sha kvartirada **qolmoqchi emas** — u yer juda shovqinli.

sentences.text: When **are** they **going to** fix the road outside our house?
sentences.translation: Uyimiz oldidagi yo'lni qachon **tuzatishmoqchi**?

sentences.text: Don't worry, Mum — I**'m not going to** drive too fast.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, oyi — tez **haydamayman**.

sentences.text: Who **is going to** look after the dog while we're in Edinburgh?
sentences.translation: Biz Edinburgdaligimizda itga kim **qarab turadi**?

examples.title: Intention or arrangement? **going to** / **-ing**
examples.description: going to — qaror (niyat), hali tashkil qilinmagan bo'lishi mumkin; Present Continuous — kelishilgan, tashkil qilingan reja (→ 19-dars).

sentences.text: Oliver **is going to** see a doctor about his back; he'll make an appointment tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Oliver beli uchun shifokorga **ko'rinmoqchi** — ertaga qabulga yoziladi.

sentences.text: Oliver **is seeing** the doctor at 9.30 on Thursday — it's all booked.
sentences.translation: Oliver payshanba kuni soat 9:30 da shifokorga **boryapti** — hammasi kelishilgan.

sentences.text: We**'re going to** look for a bigger flat, but we haven't started yet.
sentences.translation: Kattaroq kvartira **qidirmoqchimiz**, lekin hali boshlamadik.

sentences.text: We**'re moving** into the new flat on the 1st — the contract is signed.
sentences.translation: 1-sanada yangi kvartiraga **ko'chib o'tyapmiz** — shartnoma imzolangan.

sentences.text: Kate **is going to** have a party for her thirtieth, but she hasn't chosen a date.
sentences.translation: Keyt o'ttiz yoshi munosabati bilan **ziyofat qilmoqchi**, lekin hali sanani tanlamadi.

sentences.text: Kate**'s having** her party on Saturday at a restaurant in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Keyt shanba kuni Oksforddagi restoranda **ziyofat qilyapti**.

sentences.text: Madina **is going** to the cinema tonight with her cousins.
sentences.translation: Madina bugun kechqurun amakivachchalari bilan **kinoga boryapti**.

sentences.text: Madina **is going to** see that new film about Ulugbek, she says.
sentences.translation: Madina Ulug'bek haqidagi yangi filmni **ko'rmoqchi** ekan.

sentences.text: Bekzod and I **are meeting** at six, and then we**'re going to** decide where to eat.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ikkalamiz soat oltida **uchrashamiz**, keyin qayerda ovqatlanishni **hal qilmoqchimiz**.

sentences.text: **Are** you **going to** do anything special for your birthday? — Yes, **I'm having** a small dinner at home.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kuningda biror maxsus narsa **qilmoqchimisan**? — Ha, uyda kichik **kechki ovqat uyushtiryapman**.

examples.title: Signs of the future: **it's going to** rain
examples.description: Hozir ko'rinib turgan belgiga qarab bashorat: nimadir bo'lishi aniq ko'rinib turibdi. O'zbekchada «hozir ...adi», «...ib qoladi».

sentences.text: Look at those black clouds — **it's going to** pour with rain.
sentences.translation: Anovi qora bulutlarga qara — hozir **sharros yomg'ir quyadi**.

sentences.text: Watch out! That glass **is going to** fall off the table.
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'l! Anovi stakan stoldan **tushib ketadi**.

sentences.text: I feel dizzy — I think I**'m going to** faint.
sentences.translation: Boshim aylanyapti — menimcha, **hushimdan ketaman**.

sentences.text: The traffic is terrible; we**'re going to** miss our flight.
sentences.translation: Tirbandlik dahshatli, **reysimizdan qolib ketamiz**.

sentences.text: Kate looks so happy — she**'s going to** have a baby in May!
sentences.translation: Keyt juda baxtli ko'rinadi — mayda **farzand ko'radi**!

sentences.text: The car is making a horrible noise — I think it**'s going to** break down.
sentences.translation: Mashina dahshatli ovoz chiqaryapti — menimcha, hozir **buzilib qoladi**.

sentences.text: It's half past eight already! You**'re going to** be late for school.
sentences.translation: Soat sakkiz yarim bo'ldi-ya! Maktabga **kechikasan**.

sentences.text: According to the latest polls, the opposition **is going to** win the election.
sentences.translation: So'nggi so'rovnomalarga ko'ra, muxolifat saylovda **g'alaba qozonadi**.

sentences.text: Those shelves are overloaded; they**'re going to** collapse if you add any more books.
sentences.translation: Bu tokchalar haddan tashqari og'ir, yana kitob qo'ysangiz **qulab tushadi**.

sentences.text: Jasur hasn't studied at all, so he**'s going to** have problems in the exam tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Jasur umuman tayyorlanmadi, shuning uchun ertaga imtihonda **qiynaladi**.

examples.title: **was going to**: plans that didn't happen
examples.description: O'tmishdagi niyat amalga oshmagan: was / were going to + V1 — «-moqchi edim (lekin ...)». O'tmishdagi bashorat ham: I thought it was going to rain.

sentences.text: I **was going to** call you last night, but my phone died.
sentences.translation: Kecha senga **qo'ng'iroq qilmoqchi edim**, lekin telefonim o'chib qoldi.

sentences.text: We **were going to** fly to Istanbul, but the tickets were too expensive.
sentences.translation: Istanbulga **uchmoqchi edik**, lekin chiptalar juda qimmat edi.

sentences.text: Sarah **was going to** study law, but in the end she chose medicine.
sentences.translation: Sara **huquqshunoslikni o'qimoqchi edi**, lekin oxiri tibbiyotni tanladi.

sentences.text: **Weren't** you **going to** fix the tap? It's still dripping.
sentences.translation: Jo'mrakni **tuzatmoqchi emasmiding**? Hali ham tomchilayapti.

sentences.text: Aziz **was going to** resign, but the company offered him a pay rise.
sentences.translation: Aziz **ishdan ketmoqchi edi**, lekin kompaniya unga maoshini oshirishni taklif qildi.

sentences.text: I thought it **was going to** rain, so I took an umbrella — but it stayed dry all day.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir **yog'adi deb** o'ylab, soyabon oldim, lekin kun bo'yi quruq bo'ldi.

sentences.text: The match **was going to** start at seven, but it was delayed because of the storm.
sentences.translation: O'yin soat yettida **boshlanishi kerak edi**, lekin bo'ron tufayli kechiktirildi.

sentences.text: Nilufar **was** just **going to** leave when the phone rang.
sentences.translation: Nilufar endi **chiqmoqchi bo'lib turgan edi**, telefon jiringladi.

sentences.text: We **weren't going to** buy anything, but the sale was too good to miss.
sentences.translation: Hech narsa **sotib olmoqchi emas edik**, lekin chegirmani o'tkazib yuborib bo'lmasdi.

sentences.text: Everyone said the new restaurant **was going to** fail, yet it's still busy five years later.
sentences.translation: Hamma yangi restoran **kasodga uchraydi** deb aytgan edi, lekin besh yildan keyin ham u gavjum.

examples.title: Plans in the news: the council **is going to** ...
examples.description: Tashkilotlar, kompaniyalar va hukumat niyatlari — yangiliklarda going to ko'p ishlatiladi: qaror qabul qilingan, lekin hali amalga oshmagan.

sentences.text: The city council **is going to** plant ten thousand trees along the ring road.
sentences.translation: Shahar kengashi halqa yo'li bo'ylab o'n ming daraxt **ekmoqchi**.

sentences.text: The airline **is going to** cut prices on flights between Tashkent and London.
sentences.translation: Aviakompaniya Toshkent–London reyslari narxini **pasaytirmoqchi**.

sentences.text: Scientists **are going to** test the new vaccine on volunteers next year.
sentences.translation: Olimlar kelasi yil yangi vaksinani ko'ngillilarda **sinab ko'rmoqchi**.

sentences.text: **Is** the government **going to** raise taxes again? Many people are worried.
sentences.translation: Hukumat yana soliqlarni **oshirmoqchimi**? Ko'pchilik xavotirda.

sentences.text: Our school **is going to** introduce Chinese lessons from September.
sentences.translation: Maktabimiz sentyabrdan xitoy tili darslarini **joriy qilmoqchi**.

sentences.text: Two big banks **are going to** merge, according to this morning's news.
sentences.translation: Bugungi ertalabki yangiliklarga ko'ra, ikkita yirik bank **birlashmoqchi**.

sentences.text: The company **isn't going to** close the factory after all, which is great news for the town.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya zavodni **yopmaydigan bo'ldi**, bu shaharcha uchun ajoyib xabar.

sentences.text: Bukhara **is going to** host an international music festival next autumn.
sentences.translation: Kelasi kuz Buxoro xalqaro musiqa festivaliga **mezbonlik qilmoqchi**.

sentences.text: Experts warn that food prices **are going to** rise sharply because of the drought.
sentences.translation: Mutaxassislar qurg'oqchilik tufayli oziq-ovqat narxlari keskin **oshishi** haqida ogohlantirmoqda.

sentences.text: What **are** the new owners **going to** do with the old cinema building?
sentences.translation: Yangi egalar eski kinoteatr binosini nima **qilmoqchi**?

examples.title: Dialogue: New Year's resolutions
examples.description: Ikki do'st Yangi yil va'dalari haqida gaplashadi: going to (niyat va bashorat) va was going to (amalga oshmagan reja).

sentences.text: — So, have you made any New Year's resolutions? What **are** you **going to** change?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, Yangi yil uchun biror va'da berdingmi? Nimani **o'zgartirmoqchisan**?

sentences.text: — Lots of things! First, I**'m going to** get up at six every day.
sentences.translation: — Ko'p narsani! Avvalo, har kuni soat oltida **turmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: — Really? You said that last year, and you **were going to** join a gym too.
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? O'tgan yili ham shunday degan eding, sport zaliga ham **yozilmoqchi eding**.

sentences.text: — I know, I know. But this time I**'m** really **going to** do it.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman, bilaman. Lekin bu safar rostdan ham **uddalayman**.

sentences.text: — What about you? **Are** you **going to** do anything different?
sentences.translation: — Sen-chi? Biror narsani boshqacha **qilmoqchimisan**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I**'m going to** spend less time on my phone, especially at night.
sentences.translation: — Ha, telefonda kamroq vaqt **o'tkazmoqchiman**, ayniqsa kechalari.

sentences.text: — Good luck with that! Look at you — you**'re going to** check it right now.
sentences.translation: — Omad! O'zingga qara — hozir yana uni **tekshirasan**.

sentences.text: — Ha! Well, I **was going to** check the weather, but okay, I'll put it away.
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! Aslida ob-havoni **ko'rmoqchi edim**, lekin mayli, olib qo'yaman.

sentences.text: — And Madina says she**'s going to** learn to cook plov properly.
sentences.translation: — Madina esa palovni yaxshilab damlashni **o'rganmoqchi** ekan.

sentences.text: — Then we**'re** definitely **going to** visit her more often!
sentences.translation: — Unda biz albatta uning oldiga tez-tez **borib turamiz**!

examples.title: Mixed: intentions, signs and broken plans
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: niyat, kelishilgan reja, hozirgi belgiga qarab bashorat va was going to — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: My brother **is going to** retrain as a programmer — he's already started an online course.
sentences.translation: Akam dasturchilikka **qayta o'qimoqchi** — onlayn kursni allaqachon boshladi.

sentences.text: **I'm going** to the bank this afternoon; do you need anything?
sentences.translation: Bugun tushdan keyin **bankka boraman** — senga biror narsa kerakmi?

sentences.text: Be careful with that ladder — you**'re going to** fall!
sentences.translation: Narvon bilan ehtiyot bo'l — **yiqilasan**!

sentences.text: Kate **was going to** move to Australia, but she met James and stayed in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Keyt Avstraliyaga **ko'chib ketmoqchi edi**, lekin Jeyms bilan tanishib, Oksfordda qoldi.

sentences.text: **Are** you **going to** tell your parents about the accident, or **are** you **going to** keep quiet?
sentences.translation: Ota-onangga avariya haqida **aytmoqchimisan** yoki **jim turmoqchimisan**?

sentences.text: The sky over the mountains is clearing, so it**'s going to** be a beautiful day.
sentences.translation: Tog'lar ustida osmon ochilyapti, demak, kun **ajoyib bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **is flying** to Manchester on Monday, and he**'s going to** visit Old Trafford while he's there.
sentences.translation: Jasur dushanba kuni Manchesterga **uchyapti** va u yerdaligida «Old Trafford»ga **bormoqchi**.

sentences.text: We **weren't going to** say anything, but the noise from next door became unbearable.
sentences.translation: Biz hech narsa **demoqchi emas edik**, lekin qo'shnining shovqini chidab bo'lmas darajaga yetdi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza has saved enough money, so she**'s going to** buy her first car next month.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza yetarlicha pul yig'di, shuning uchun kelasi oy birinchi mashinasini **sotib olmoqchi**.

sentences.text: I thought the exam **was going to** be easy, but it was the hardest one I've ever taken.
sentences.translation: Imtihon oson **bo'ladi deb** o'ylagandim, lekin u hayotimdagi eng qiyin imtihon bo'ldi.
